paragraphs: Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. and its subsidiaries (together, "Indivior" or the "Company") is the market leader in long-acting injectable medications for opioid use disorder (OUD). Indivior is focused on delivering evidence-based pharmacotherapies for OUD and is committed to advancing the neurobiological understanding of OUD as a chronic, relapsing, but treatable brain disease. For more than 25 years, Indivior has led innovation in addiction medicine, developing differentiated therapeutic solutions that support long-term patient recovery, expand access to care, and drive sustainable value for patients, healthcare systems and stockholders.

Headquartered in the U.S. in Richmond, Virginia, Indivior and its portfolio of products is available primarily in the U.S. with additional products available in Canada, Australia, France, and Germany.
Our core products include the following approved treatments: •SUBLOCADE (buprenorphine extended-release monthly injection); and
•SUBOXONE Film (buprenorphine and naloxone sublingual film);

both of which are treatments for OUD. Product availability varies across the countries in which Indivior treatments are available, including in terms of dosage, strength and indication. Our core geographic market (based on the country where the sale originates) is the U.S., which accounted for 85%, 85%, and 83% of net revenues for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively. In the U.S., we sell only SUBLOCADE and SUBOXONE Film.

Our business was initially developed and managed as a separate division of Reckitt Benckiser Group PLC ("RB" and, together with its subsidiaries, the "RB Group"), a public limited company incorporated under the laws of England and Wales. Indivior PLC was incorporated on September 26, 2014, for the purpose of acquiring the specialty pharmaceutical business unit from RB (the "Demerger"). Following the Demerger, which was effective on December 23, 2014, Indivior PLC operated as a standalone business.

On December 11, 2025, our stockholders approved a plan to change our domicile to the U.S. On January 23, 2026, Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a corporation formed in Delaware on October 28, 2025 ("Indivior Pharmaceuticals"), became the ultimate parent company of Indivior PLC, a public company limited by shares incorporated under the laws of England and Wales ("Indivior PLC"), and its subsidiaries pursuant to a court-approved scheme of arrangement under Part 26 of the U.K. Companies Act 2006 (the "Scheme of Arrangement") as part of Indivior PLC's previously announced intention to change its corporate domicile to the United States (the "U.S. Domestication"). Pursuant to the Scheme of Arrangement, each ordinary share in the capital of Indivior PLC was cancelled. In consideration for this cancellation, each stockholder received one share of common stock, par value $0.001 per share, of Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. for every ordinary share they previously held in Indivior PLC. After the delivery of the order of the High Court of Justice in England and Wales sanctioning the Scheme of Arrangement to the Registrar of Companies in England and Wales, and after the close of market trading on January 23, 2026, the Scheme of Arrangement became effective and binding on all stockholders of Indivior PLC and Indivior PLC became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc., thereby completing the U.S. Domestication. After this order, Indivior PLC became Indivior Limited.

Previously, the ordinary shares of Indivior PLC were listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market ("Nasdaq") and registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act") prior to the U.S. Domestication. The issuance of shares of common stock of Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. pursuant to the Scheme of Arrangement was exempt from registration under Section

3(a)(10) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act"). Further, pursuant to Rule 12g-3(a) under the Exchange Act, Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is the successor issuer to Indivior PLC and Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc.'s common stock is therefore deemed to be registered under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act.

Because the U.S. Domestication was completed after December 31, 2025, the financial statements included herein are those of Indivior PLC. The U.S. Domestication will be accounted for as a common-control transaction in Q1 2026 and the historical financial statements of Indivior PLC will become the historical financial statements of Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. The corporate reorganization will have no impact to historical revenues, expenses, assets, liabilities, or cash flows.

A significant breakthrough in the treatment of OUD occurred in the US during the 1960s with the expansion of methadone treatment and the creation of opioid treatment programs. In 1966, Reckitt & Colman (which would become RB) led the breakthrough discovery of buprenorphine. Throughout the 1970s and 1980s, Reckitt & Colman provided buprenorphine to scientists studying new therapeutic options for OUD. In 1994, a Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (CRADA) was signed between Reckitt & Colman and the U.S. National Institute on Drug Abuse ("NIDA") to develop a buprenorphine and a buprenorphine/naloxone transmucosal medication for the treatment of OUD. SUBUTEX Tablet (buprenorphine sublingual tablet) was our first approved product specifically indicated for the treatment of OUD. SUBUTEX Tablet first received marketing approval in France in July 1995 and was subsequently launched there in February 1996 by Schering-Plough under license from Reckitt & Colman. Shortly thereafter, SUBUTEX Tablet was approved in additional EU countries. SUBOXONE Tablet (buprenorphine/naloxone sublingual tablet) was approved across the EU by the EMA in September 2006.
Launch of SUBUTEX Tablets, SUBOXONE Tablets, and SUBOXONE Film in the U.S.

The FDA approved SUBUTEX Tablet and SUBOXONE Tablet for the treatment of OUD in October 2002 and both products were launched in the U.S. in 2003. Subsequently, in August 2010, the FDA approved SUBOXONE Film (buprenorphine/naloxone sublingual film). We discontinued the U.S. distribution of SUBUTEX Tablets in 2011 and SUBOXONE Tablets in 2013. In 2020, the Company's U.S. sales force ceased promoting SUBOXONE Film as part of the Resolution Agreement with the Department of Justice ("DOJ"), discussed below, and ceased all detailing of the product in that year, though it remains available for sale.

The FDA approved SUBLOCADE (buprenorphine extended-release injection for subcutaneous use) in November 2017 and we launched sales of this product in 2018. As the first monthly buprenorphine-based injectable formulation of buprenorphine approved by the FDA for the treatment of moderate to severe OUD, SUBLOCADE became the largest product by net revenue for the Company by the second quarter of 2022.

headings: Risks Related to our Company and Its Business
We are subject to risks related to the manufacture and distribution of our products globally and must meet stringent current Good Manufacturing Practices.
We rely heavily on SUBLOCADE for a significant portion of our revenues.
Our revenues may grow at a slower than expected rate or decrease due to many factors.
We rely on third parties to manufacture, package, test, and distribute our products and their facilities and processes must meet stringent regulatory requirements.
We are subject to additional risks because we import, manufacture, and distribute controlled substances.

The clinical study or commercial use of our products may cause unintended side effects or adverse reactions, or incidents of misuse may occur, which could adversely affect our products, business and share price.

Congressional action to reduce spending may result in cuts to Medicaid which in turn might impair access to our products in the U.S., thereby adversely affecting our revenues and results of operations.
Failure to retain key personnel or attract new personnel could have a material adverse effect on us.

As the leader in long-acting injectable treatments for opioid use disorder (OUD), Indivior is singularly focused on delivering evidence-based treatment and advancing understanding of OUD as a chronic but treatable brain disease. For more than 25 years, we have revolutionized the science of addiction medicine — developing treatments that help people move toward long-term recovery with independence and dignity. Building on this heritage, we are ushering in a new era, renewing our commitment to individuals living with OUD and carrying forward what matters most: compassion, integrity, and science. Together – with science, people living with OUD, public health champions, and communities, we are powering recovery and renewing hope.

The Company operates as one business segment, which is predominantly the development, manufacture and sale of buprenorphine-based prescription drugs for the treatment of opioid dependence and related disorders. Substantially all our net revenue for 2025 and 2024 was derived from sales of SUBLOCADE and other buprenorphine-based sublingual products (including SUBOXONE Film and SUBOXONE Tablet). SUBLOCADE accounted for 69% and 64% of our net revenue in 2025 and 2024, respectively. Other buprenorphine-based sublingual products accounted for 28% and 32% of our net revenue in 2025 and 2024, respectively.

Our net revenue is affected by patient awareness, patient willingness to seek treatment, and the number of eligible healthcare providers available to administer treatment. Competitive dynamics may exert pricing pressure and may also affect decisions by third‑party payors regarding formulary placement and reimbursement coverage. To support increased patient access, we engage with governmental agencies, key opinion leaders in addiction medicine, and healthcare professionals to inform policy development and highlight patient outcomes.

In 2025, U.S. buprenorphine medication‑assisted treatment (BMAT) volume continued to grow at a mid‑single‑digit rate. The Company continues to expect long‑term U.S. BMAT market growth to remain within the mid‑single‑digit percentage range, reflecting public awareness of the opioid epidemic and approved treatments, as well as regulatory and legislative actions intended to expand access to BMAT therapies. The U.S. long‑acting injectable (LAI) segment grew in the high‑teens percentage range during the period. SUBLOCADE remains the primary long‑acting injectable treatment utilized for opioid use disorder. The Company's share of the LAI segment has stabilized in the mid‑seventy percent range. The Company expects to continue investing at sustained levels to support further LAI penetration by increasing patient awareness and advancing policies designed to improve patient access to treatment.

In the U.S., we have distribution agreements with the three largest wholesalers, which accounted for 51% and 55% of our global net revenue in 2025 and 2024, respectively. These wholesalers, in turn, distribute our products through various channels including the following:

•Commercial managed care. This category comprises insurance programs intended to reduce the cost of providing health benefits and improve the quality of care to their members. One of the most common forms of managed care is the use of a panel or network of healthcare providers that provide care to enrollees. Also within commercial managed care is the Medicare Part D Program, a program regulated and funded by the U.S. government generally for senior citizens and administered by private insurance companies.

•Medicaid. Medicaid is a jointly funded, Federal-State health insurance program that covers children, the aged, blind, and/or disabled and other people who are eligible to receive federally assisted income maintenance payments, including prescription drugs. We are obligated to offer "Best Price" under Medicaid, being the lowest price at which the manufacturer sells a drug to any purchaser in any pricing structure (inclusive of discounts and rebates).

•Federal. This channel encompasses the provision of outpatient drugs to federal government purchasers, including the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and the Department of Defense, or under the 340B Program. Pricing discounts are provided separately for drugs provided under these programs.
•Pharmacy. This channel covers end-customers paying cash directly at the pharmacy. Often, we provide discount coupons to customers who buy our products without pharmaceutical benefit coverage.

Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 以及其子公司（合稱為 "Indivior" 或 "本公司"）為長效注射劑用於阿片類藥物使用失序（OUD）的市場領導者。Indivior 致力於提供基於證據的藥物治療方案用以 OUD，並致力於進展對 OUD 作為一種慢性、易復發但可治療的大腦疾病的神經生物學理解。在超過 25 年的時間裡，Indivior 領導了戒癮醫學的創新，開發出差異化的治療方案，以支持患者的長期復健、擴大照護的可近性，並為患者、醫療系統與股東創造可持續的價值。
Indivior 設立於美國維吉尼亞州里奇蒙市，Indivior 及其產品組合主要於美國銷售，並在加拿大、澳洲、法國與德國有額外產品可供銷售。
我們的核心產品包括以下核准的治療方案：•SUBLOCADE（緩釋每月注射劑型的丁丙諾啡）；以及
•SUBOXONE 薄膜（丁丙諾啡與納洛酮的舌下薄膜）；

兩者皆為 OUD 的治療方案。產品的可得性因 Indivior 治療方案在各國的銷售情況而有所不同，包括劑型、劑量與適應症。我們的核心地理市場（根據銷售來源國家）為美國，美國在 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止年度、2024 年 12 月 31 日結止年度與 2023 年 12 月 31 日結止年度的淨銷售額中，分別佔 85%、85% 與 83%。在美國，我們僅銷售 SUBLOCADE 與 SUBOXONE 薄膜。

我們的業務最初是作為 Reckitt Benckiser Group PLC（"RB" 以及與其子公司合稱為 "RB Group"）的一個獨立部門開發與管理的，RB Group 為根據英格蘭及威爾斯法律設立的公開有限公司。Indivior PLC 於 2014 年 9 月 26 日設立，目的是為取得 RB（"分拆"）的專門藥物業務單位。在分拆生效後，即 2014 年 12 月 23 日，Indivior PLC 運作為一個獨立的業務。

2025 年 12 月 11 日，我們的股東批准了一項計畫，將我們的註冊地變更至美國。2026 年 1 月 23 日，Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc.（於 2025 年 10 月 28 日在特拉華州設立的公司，"Indivior Pharmaceuticals"）成為 Indivior PLC（根據英格蘭及威爾斯法律設立的公開有限公司，"Indivior PLC"）及其子公司之最終母公司，根據英國 2006 年公司法第 26 章核准的法院批准之安排計畫（"安排計畫"）進行，作為 Indivior PLC 預先宣佈的變更公司註冊地至美國（"美國本土化"）計畫的一部分。根據安排計畫，Indivior PLC 資本中的每一普通股皆被註銷。作為對此註銷的對價，每位股東可獲得一張 Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 普通股（每股面值 $0.001），對應其原先持有的 Indivior PLC 普通股。在英國英格蘭及威爾斯高等法院核准安排計畫的命令交付給英格蘭及威爾斯公司註冊處後，並在 2026 年 1 月 23 日市場交易結束後，安排計畫生效並對所有 Indivior PLC 股東具有約束力，Indivior PLC 成為 Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 的 wholly-owned 子公司，從而完成美國本土化。在該命令後，Indivior PLC 成為 Indivior Limited。
此前，Indivior PLC 的普通股於納斯達克全球選選市場（"納斯達克"）上市，並根據 1934 年證券交易法第 12(b) 節（"證券交易法"）進行登記，於美國本土化前。根據安排計畫發行 Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 普通股的行為，根據第 15 節豁免於註冊要求。
1933年證券法第3(a)(10)條，經1933年證券法修正案（"證券法"）修正。此外，根據證券交易法第12g-3(a)條規則，Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc.為Indivior PLC的繼承發行者，因此Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc.的普通股被視為已根據證券交易法第12(b)條註冊。
由於美國本土化是在2025年12月31日之後完成，因此本文件所包含的財務報表為Indivior PLC的財務報表。美國本土化將被視為一項共同控制交易，於2026年第一季進行會計處理，Indivior PLC的歷史財務報表將成為Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc.的歷史財務報表。此公司重組不會影響歷史收入、費用、資產、負債或現金流量。

在美國，治療阿片類藥物使用失能（OUD）的重大突破發生於1960年代，隨著嗎啡治療的擴展以及阿片類藥物治療計畫的建立。1966年，Reckitt & Colman（後為RB）領導了布丙諾啡的突破性發現。在1970年代和1980年代，Reckitt & Colman將布丙諾啡提供給研究新治療選項的科學家。1994年，Reckitt & Colman與美國國家藥物濫用研究所（"NIDA"）簽署了一項合作研究與發展協議（CRADA），以開發一種布丙諾啡和布丙諾啡/納洛酮經黏膜給藥的藥物，用於治療OUD。SUBUTEX錠（布丙諾啡舌下錠）為本公司首個專門用於治療OUD的核准產品。SUBUTEX錠於1995年7月首先獲得法國的市場核准，並於1996年2月由Schering-Plough在Reckitt & Colman的授權下於法國上市。不久之後，SUBUTEX錠也獲得了其他歐盟國家的核准。SUBOXONE錠（布丙諾啡/納洛酮舌下錠）於2006年9月獲得歐盟藥物管理局（EMA）核准於歐盟上市。
SUBUTEX錠、SUBOXONE錠及SUBOXONE薄膜於美國上市

美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）於2002年10月核准SUBUTEX錠與SUBOXONE錠用於治療OUD，並於2003年在美國上市。隨後，於2010年8月，FDA核准SUBOXONE薄膜（布丙諾啡/納洛酮舌下薄膜）。本公司於2011年停止美國SUBUTEX錠的銷售，於2013年停止美國SUBOXONE錠的銷售。2020年，本公司美國銷售團隊根據與美國司法部（"DOJ"）討論的和解協議，停止推廣SUBOXONE薄膜，並在該年停止所有產品的推廣活動，儘管該產品仍可供銷售。
美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）於2017年11月核准SUBLOCADE（布丙諾啡緩釋注射劑，用於皮下給藥），並於2018年開始銷售此產品。作為美國食品藥物管理局核准的第一種每月一次的布丙諾啡基注射劑，用於治療中度至嚴重的OUD，SUBLOCADE在2022年第二季成為本公司淨營收最大的產品。

作為長效注射治療阿片使用障礙（OUD）之領導者，Indivior 唯一專注於提供基於證據之治療，並推進對 OUD 為一種慢性但可治療之腦部疾病之理解。超過 25 年來，我們已革新成癮醫學之科學——開發治療方式，協助人們朝向長期復原，並擁有獨立與尊嚴。基於此傳統，我們正引領一個新時代，重申對 OUD 患者之承諾，並持續推動最重要的事：同理心、正直與科學。我們與科學、OUD 患者、公共衛生倡導者及社區共同行動，推動復原並重燃希望。

本公司營運為單一應報告分部，主要為開發、製造及銷售用於治療阿片依賴及相關疾病之含布吡諾啡處方藥物。2025 年及 2024 年之幾乎所有淨營收均來自 SUBLOCADE 及其他含布吡諾啡舌下產品（包括 SUBOXONE 膠片及 SUBOXONE 薄片）之銷售。SUBLOCADE 在 2025 年及 2024 年分別佔本公司淨營收之 69% 及 64%。其他含布吡諾啡舌下產品在 2025 年及 2024 年分別佔本公司淨營收之 28% 及 32%。
本公司之淨營收受患者認知度、患者尋求治療之意願及可提供治療之合格醫療人員數量影響。競爭態勢可能造成價格壓力，也可能影響第三方支付者有關藥品列入處方清單及給付範圍之決策。為支持增加患者接觸，本公司與政府機構、成癮醫學之關鍵意見領袖及醫療專業人員合作，以推動政策發展並強調患者治療成果。

2025 年，美國布普侖啡（buprenorphine）藥物輔助治療（BMAT）用量持續以中位數單位數成長率成長。本公司持續預期美國 BMAT 市場長遠成長率將維持在中位數單位數百分比範圍內，反映民眾對阿片類藥物濫用危機的認知以及核准的治療方式，以及旨在擴大 BMAT 治療方式取得的法規與立法行動。美國長效注射劑（LAI）分部在該期間成長幅度為高 teens 百分比範圍。SUBLOCADE 延續為治療阿片類藥物濫用的主要長效注射劑。本公司在 LAI 分部的市佔率已穩定在中位數七十百分比範圍內。本公司預期將持續投資於穩定層級，以支持進一步 LAI 產品的滲透率，透過提高患者認知以及推進旨在改善患者取得治療的政策。
在美國，我們與三大最大經銷商簽有經銷協議，這些經銷商在 2025 年及 2024 年分別佔本公司全球淨銷售額的 51% 與 55%。這些經銷商則透過各種通路分銷我們的產品，包括以下通路：
•商業醫療保險。此類別包含旨在降低提供健康福利成本並改善其成員照護品質的保險計畫。商業醫療保險中最常見的形式是使用一個醫療提供者名單或網路，為 enrollees 提供照護。商業醫療保險中也包含 Medicare Part D 計畫，此計畫由美國政府監管並經費，主要服務年長者，並由私人保險公司管理。
•醫療補助（Medicaid）。醫療補助是美國聯邦與州政府共同經費的健康保險計畫，覆蓋兒童、年長者、視障者及/或殘障者及其他符合資格接受聯邦資助收入維生補貼的人士，包括處方藥。我們有義務在醫療補助計畫中提供 "Best Price"，即製造商向任何購販者銷售藥物的最低價格（包含折扣與回扣）。
•聯邦政府。此通路涵蓋向聯邦政府購販者提供門診藥物，包括美國退伍軍人事務部及國防部，或根據 340B 計畫。這些計畫提供的藥物會另外提供價格折扣。
•藥房。此通路涵蓋消費者直接在藥房現金付款購買產品。通常，我們會為未享有藥物福利覆蓋的消費者提供折扣 Coupons。

headings: 與本公司及其業務相關的風險
我們面臨與在全球範圍內製造和分銷產品相關的風險，並必須符合嚴格的當前良好製造規範。
我們嚴重依賴 SUBLOCADE 來產生我們收入的很大一部分。
我們的收入可能成長速率低於預期，或出現下降，原因可能有多種因素。
我們依賴第三方製造、包裝、測試和分銷我們的產品，其設施和流程必須符合嚴格的監管要求。
我們面臨額外風險，因為我們進口、製造和分銷管制藥物。
我們產品的臨牀研究或商業使用可能導致未預期的副作用或不良反應，或發生濫用事件，這可能會對我們的產品、業務和股價產生不利影響。
國會對減支的行動可能導致 Medicaid 費用削減，進而可能影響我們產品在美國的可取得性，因此可能對我們的營業收入及營運成果造成不利影響。
未能留住關鍵人才或吸引新進人才，可能對我們造成重大不利影響。
